raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner explicitly instructed WebSurfer to open authoritative sources and confirm songwriter credits with citations, but at Step 5 WebSurfer only repeated a DuckDuckGo search, relied on snippets, and did not open or cite any authoritative pages (ASCAP/BMI, AllMusic, Discogs, or even the Wikipedia article itself). This introduced a misleading Genius snippet (claiming Lee Alexander) without resolving the conflict and led to repetitive, unproductive loops rather than definitive verification.
